verdict.rationale: Elicit natively generates AI insights from the user's own papers. Chat can compare, summarize along dimensions and cluster papers. Zotero and Library imports feed AI extraction and analysis. Research reports, screening recommendations and Routines that write summaries are also documented, and a hands-on user reported getting cited concept lists in about a minute. Several hands-on reports of incorrect or hallucinated summaries are about accuracy rather than absence of the capability, so they lower quality and confidence but not the verdict. missing for 10: independent evidence that insights are reliably accurate, explicit documentation of proactive suggestions beyond screening recommendations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Chat enables you to: Compare and contrast papers - Summarize multiple papers along specific dimensions (like their methodologies) - Cluster papers by a certain topic
Elicit's Zotero integration helps you bring your paper collections into Elicit, where you can extract data and analyze your papers!
A Routine can act on what it finds and hand you a finished analysis: it can filter on criteria an Alert couldn't, update an artifact, or write the summary
Pro, Scale, and Enterprise subscribers can export tables from Systematic Reviews, including the screening recommendation tables and the data extraction table.
